title: 논리의 끝
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop City Pop track in G Major at 115 BPM. The arrangement features a clean, funk-influenced electric guitar playing syncopated 16th-note muted strums and occasional melodic fills. A slap bass guitar follows the kick drum pattern with percussive pops. The drum kit uses a crisp snare with a short plate reverb and a tight kick drum. Bright polyphonic analog synth pads provide harmonic sustain, while a secondary FM synth plays staccato bell-like counter-melodies. Female vocals are processed with light compression and a subtle chorus effect, delivered in a rhythmic, conversational style in the verses and a melodic, airy tone in the pre-chorus. A subtle shaker and tambourine accent the off-beats.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[clean funk electric guitar, slap bass, tight drum kit, bright synth pads]

[Verse 1]
[rhythmic female vocals]
좋아하는 사람이 생겼잖아
인스타에서 봤어 프로필을 열었어
사진을 넘겼어 친구에게 말했어
이 사람 좋아 어떻게 해야 해
[staccato bell synth enters]
친구가 말했어 DM 보내
안녕이라고 그게 전부야

[Pre-Chorus]
[airy vocal delivery, synth pads swell]
메시지 창을 열었어 커서가 깜빡여
안녕 이거 하나 치는데 30분이 걸렸어
예전에는 편지 썼잖아
[bass slides up]
주소를 적고 우표를 붙이고 우체
